user.title: Set up Family Tasks
user.description: Family Tasks manages tasks and family members itself via Settings; this just sets a display name once.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Family Tasks can only be set up once.

data.battery_alert_auto_complete_on_recovery: Auto-complete battery alert tasks once the battery recovers
data.screen_time_minutes_per_point: Screen time minutes per invested point
data.screen_time_tick_minutes: Screen time per automatic tick (minutes, matches the Handyzeit blueprint)
data.screen_time_ticks_per_day: Automatic ticks per day (matches the Handyzeit blueprint)
data.malus_threshold_1_points: Handyzeit malus stage 1: below this = -6 min per tick (from this many points last week: -5 min)
data.malus_threshold_2_points: Handyzeit malus stage 2: from this many points last week: -3 min per tick
data.malus_threshold_3_points: Handyzeit malus stage 3: from this many points last week: -2 min per tick
data.malus_threshold_4_points: Handyzeit malus stage 4: from this many points last week: -1 min per tick (no malus from the weekly goal onward)
data.coin_threshold_1_points: Coin threshold 1 – silver (points per week, milestone bonus coins)
data.coin_threshold_2_points: Coin threshold 2 – gold (points per week, milestone bonus coins and streak bonus)
data.milestone_150_bonus_coins: Meilensteinbonus coins when reaching coin threshold 1 (silver)
data.milestone_200_bonus_coins: Meilensteinbonus coins when reaching coin threshold 2 (gold)
data.streak_bonus_2_weeks_coins: Streak-Bonus coins for staying above coin threshold 2 for 2 weeks in a row
data.streak_bonus_3_weeks_coins: Streak-Bonus coins for staying above coin threshold 2 for 3 weeks in a row (paid every further qualifying week too)
data.spotify_threshold_points: Spotify unlock: minimum points last week for Spotify to be unlocked this week (0 = off)
data.top_scorer_bonus_coins: Bonus coins for the member with the most points in a week, but only if they also reached the weekly point goal (0 disables it; no bonus on a tie, and none if the weekly goal is unmet)

error.thresholds_not_ascending: Thresholds must be strictly ascending: malus 1 < 2 < 3 < 4 < weekly goal < coin threshold 1 < 2.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Marks the current period of a task as done and awards points to the responsible family member. If that member is a child, the task is only marked 'awaiting confirmation' and a confirmation task is raised for the parents instead.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (see the status sensor's attributes).

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Optional: complete the task on behalf of a member other than the one currently assigned by rotation.

skip_task.name: Skip task
skip_task.description: Skips the current period of a task without awarding points and without advancing the rotation. If task_id is an auto-generated parent confirmation task, this rejects the child's claim instead - see 'note'.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (see the status sensor's attributes).

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional: only used when rejecting a child's completion claim - an explanation shown/notified to the child for why it wasn't accepted.

toggle_subtask.name: Toggle checklist item
toggle_subtask.description: Checks or unchecks one sub-item of a task's checklist. The task itself is marked done once every sub-item is checked.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task the checklist belongs to (see the status sensor's attributes).

subtask_id.name: Sub-item ID
subtask_id.description: The sub-item's ID (see the status sensor's 'subtasks' attribute).

claim_task.name: Claim task
claim_task.description: Reserves a task's current period for one member for 60 minutes. While reserved, nobody else may claim or complete it. If it isn't marked done in time, the claimant loses one point and the task reopens for everyone. Only possible when more than one member currently qualifies for the task.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (see the status sensor's attributes).

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Optional: claim the task on behalf of a member other than the calling user.

release_task.name: Release task
release_task.description: Gives back a task claimed via 'Claim task' before its reservation expires, with no point penalty. The claimant themself may always do this; a parent may also release any member's claim this way.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (see the status sensor's attributes).

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Optional: release the reservation on behalf of a member other than the calling user.

reset_points.name: Reset points
reset_points.description: Resets stored points data: the completion log/history, reward redemptions, and Meilenstein-/Streak-Bonus tracking. Tasks, members, and the reward catalog itself are left untouched.

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Optional: only reset this member's points data. Left empty, every member is reset.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a new task. Returns the stored item including its ID.

task.name: Task
task.description: Task definition as an object. Required: name, recurrence, rotation. recurrence = {type: daily | weekly | interval_days | yearly | once | trigger | battery, weekdays: [0-6, 0 = Monday] (weekly), interval + anchor_date (interval_days), anchor_date (yearly/once), trigger (trigger)}. rotation = {member_ids: [...], strategy: round_robin | random | fixed | least_points}; an empty member_ids list makes it an Aufgabenpool task. Optional: icon, points, coin_value, enabled, due_time (HH:MM), overdue_time (HH:MM), requires_confirmation, kind (standard | mandatory), subtasks ([{id, name}]), vacation_behavior (show | pause), note, completion_button_entity_id.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Changes individual fields of an existing task. Returns the updated item.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Only the fields to change (same fields as create_task). A field is replaced as a whole, e.g. a new rotation replaces the old one. null clears overdue_time, completion_button_entity_id and note.

list_tasks.name: List tasks
list_tasks.description: Returns all tasks with their stored definition. With include_status, each task also carries its current computed state (open, overdue, done ...) under 'current'.

include_status.name: Include status
include_status.description: Also return each task's current computed state.

create_member.name: Create family member
create_member.description: Creates a new family member. Returns the stored item including its ID.

member.name: Family member
member.description: Member as an object. Required: name. Optional: person_entity_id, icon, active, role (parent | child), participates_in_rewards, paused, notify_service.

update_member.name: Update family member
update_member.description: Changes individual fields of an existing family member. Returns the updated item.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Only the fields to change (same fields as create_member). null clears notify_service.

list_members.name: List family members
list_members.description: Returns all members. With include_summary, each member also carries points (today, week, month, total), open tasks and the coin balance under 'current'.

include_summary.name: Include summary
include_summary.description: Also return each member's points, open tasks and coin balance.

create_favorite.name: Create Favorit
create_favorite.description: Creates a new Favorit. Returns the stored item including its ID.

favorite.name: Favorit
favorite.description: Favorit (task template) as an object. Required: name. Optional: icon, points, coin_value, member_ids, kind (standard | mandatory), subtasks ([{id, name}]), note.

update_favorite.name: Update Favorit
update_favorite.description: Changes individual fields of an existing Favorit. Returns the updated item.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Only the fields to change (same fields as create_favorite). null clears note.

create_reward.name: Create reward
create_reward.description: Creates a new reward. Returns the stored item including its ID.

reward.name: Reward
reward.description: Reward as an object. Required: name. Optional: icon, coin_cost, screen_time_minutes, auto_fulfill, screen_time_investable, note_enabled, note_label.

update_reward.name: Update reward
update_reward.description: Changes individual fields of an existing reward. Returns the updated item.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Only the fields to change (same fields as create_reward). null clears screen_time_minutes and note_label.

create_battery_override.name: Create battery override
create_battery_override.description: Creates a new battery override. Returns the stored item including its ID.

battery_override.name: Battery override
battery_override.description: Battery override as an object. Required: entity_id. Optional: excluded (true = ignore this battery), threshold (warning level in percent; leave out to use the default).

update_battery_override.name: Update battery override
update_battery_override.description: Changes individual fields of an existing battery override. Returns the updated item.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Only the fields to change: excluded, threshold. null clears threshold (back to the default).

list_battery_overrides.name: List battery overrides
list_battery_overrides.description: Returns all battery overrides (excluded batteries and individual warning levels).

instantiate_favorite.name: Create task from Favorit
instantiate_favorite.description: Creates a new one-time task from a Favorit template. The Favorit itself stays unchanged. Returns the new task.

member_ids.name: Members
member_ids.description: Optional: list of member IDs the task is assigned to instead of the Favorit's own members.

award_points.name: Award points
award_points.description: Gives a member points, or deducts them with a negative number. Counts towards the weekly progress like a completed task.

points.name: Points
points.description: Points to award; negative to deduct. Not 0.

note.name: Reason
note.description: Optional reason shown in the log.

award_coins.name: Award coins
award_coins.description: Gives a member coins, or deducts them with a negative number (limited to the current balance).

coins.name: Coins
coins.description: Coins to award; negative to deduct. Not 0.

note.name: Reason
note.description: Optional reason shown in the coin log.

extend_task_deadline.name: Extend task deadline
extend_task_deadline.description: Gives the currently open occurrence of a task more time before it becomes overdue. The task definition is not changed. Returns the new deadline.

only_open.name: Only open
only_open.description: Only redemptions that are not yet marked as fulfilled.

fulfill_reward_redemption.name: Mark redemption fulfilled
fulfill_reward_redemption.description: Marks a redeemed reward as fulfilled (or open again).

get_settings.name: Get settings
get_settings.description: Returns the household-wide options (weekly goal, bonuses, thresholds, Handyzeit values ...), the thresholds actually in effect and whether vacation mode is currently active.

update_settings.name: Update settings
update_settings.description: Changes individual household-wide options. Options not mentioned stay as they are; null resets an option (thresholds fall back to the value derived from the weekly goal). Vacation mode itself is switched with the vacation mode switch entity.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Options to change. Keys: overdue_after_minutes, default_rotation_strategy, battery_warning_threshold, battery_alert_auto_complete_on_recovery, screen_time_minutes_per_point, screen_time_tick_minutes, screen_time_ticks_per_day, screen_time_malus_start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), weekly_progress_goal_points, malus_threshold_1_points .. malus_threshold_4_points, coin_threshold_1_points, coin_threshold_2_points, milestone_150_bonus_coins, milestone_200_bonus_coins, streak_bonus_2_weeks_coins, streak_bonus_3_weeks_coins, top_scorer_bonus_coins, spotify_threshold_points, vacation_mode_default. Thresholds must be strictly ascending: malus 1 < 2 < 3 < 4 < weekly goal < coin 1 < coin 2.
